note: Wednesday B, Cantonese speaking（粤语口语）, light. 事 si6 ×3 first. Hard-first: 我傳咗俾你啦. Recap Saturday lines (遲啲再覆你 etc.), then 3 new workplace lines to shadow, a 1-min take (point → reason → example), 5-Q quiz, end with Hard. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: Read / shadow the 3 new workplace lines (Hub Play may be silent — use the mp3: audio/cantonese/wed25_yue_lines.mp3)

lines.gloss: ngo5 tung4 nei5 kok3 jing6 haa5
lines.translation: I'll confirm with you. · 我跟你确认一下。

lines.gloss: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gaau2 dim6 keoi5
lines.translation: I'll get it done today. · 我今天搞定它。

lines.gloss: jau5 me1 man6 tai4 ceoi4 si4 wan2 ngo5
lines.translation: Find me anytime if there is any problem. · 有问题随时找我。

tasks.prompt: Shadow the 3 new lines ×3 (audio: audio/cantonese/wed25_yue_lines.mp3; Hub Play may be silent), then say them without the script. Then a 1-minute take: point → reason → example. Point: tell a colleague you will confirm and finish it today. Reason: so they can plan. Example: offer to be found anytime.
tasks.script: 我同你確認吓。 ngo5 tung4 nei5 kok3 jing6 haa5 · 我今日搞掂佢。 ngo5 gam1 jat6 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 · 有咩問題隨時搵我。 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 ceoi4 si4 wan2 ngo5

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。

options: I've sent it over to you.
questions.explain: 傳咗 cyun4 zo2 = have sent. 已经发给你了。

options: I'll get back to you later.
questions.explain: 遲啲 = later; 覆 = reply. 稍后再回复你。
搞掂 gaau2 dim6 = get it sorted. 我今天搞定它。
隨時 = anytime; 搵 = look for. 随时找我。
